title: Ring-induced localizations of nilpotent groups
summary: For a commutative ring $R$, we study the $R$-localization functor on the category of groups, defined as localization with respect to the homomorphism $\mathbb{Z}\to R$. Our main result is that, when $R$ is a binomial ring, the $R$-localization of a nilpotent group is again nilpotent. Taking $R=\mathbb{Z}_p$, the ring of $p$-adic integers, yields a new example of a localization functor that preserves nilpotency.
